name: Indian Railway delay analysis
description: Built an end-to-end Indian Railway Delay Analysis dashboard project using Python, Pandas, and Power BI to analyze train delays, congestion patterns, operational bottlenecks, and seasonal trends across railway stations.

Performed extensive data cleaning, feature engineering, KPI development, and exploratory analysis to uncover actionable insights related to severe delays, station congestion, weekday vs weekend traffic, and monthly performance trends.

Designed a multi-page interactive Power BI dashboard with advanced visual storytelling, slicers, operational analytics, and business intelligence insights to support data-driven railway performance optimization.

name: Fake job posting analytics

Strengthened skills in data visualization, fraud pattern analysis, and business storytelling through data.

name: Airline Operations & Delay Analytics Dashboard
description: Built a premium multi-page Airline Operations & Delay Analytics dashboard using Power BI to analyze nationwide flight operations, delays, cancellations, airport congestion, and airline performance across millions of flight records.

Performed extensive data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and KPI validation using Python, Pandas, NumPy, Google Colab, and VS Code before importing optimized parquet datasets into Power BI.

Designed cinematic storytelling dashboards featuring operational intelligence, delay root-cause analysis, airline benchmarking, congestion analytics, and executive insights using advanced DAX calculations and modern visualization techniques.

Developed interactive analytical pages including operational overview, delay intelligence, airline performance benchmarking, and airport congestion analysis to support data-driven aviation decision-making.
